skills.name: Jade Echoing (玉响/玉響)
skills.line: Listen, it's the sound of the ice cracking.
skills.description: SP Yuki Onna creates an ice dart in her hands to attack a single target dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK.

skills.name: Frost Breath (息吹)
skills.line: When the bitter wind blows, everything is frozen.
skills.description:
Exclusive effect.
SP Yuki Onna increases the DEF for all allies by 30%. At the end of a turn for an ally or enemy (excluding summoned entities), she creates 1 stack of Flower of Ice. When an ally other than herself takes lethal damage, they become Bound in Ice to occupy their spot but are regarded as KO'd. ;Upon Usage :If there is an ally Bound in Ice on the battlefield, SP Yuki Onna will revive all allies Bound in Ice and recovers their max HP to full.
After usage, this skill changes to Spring's Arrival. ;Flower of Ice (氷花) : :'''General, Mark''': If SP Yuki Onna is not Immobile, she emits an Ice Nova every time she has 6 stacks. Ice Nova deals indirect damage equal to 100% of her ATK to all allies, other than herself, and enemies. This damage does not trigger passives.

upgrades.text: Damage for Ice Nova dealt to Frostbound enemies is increased by 50%.
SP Yuki Onna gains 50 SPD for every ally Bound in Ice.
Damage for Ice Nova dealt to allies is decreased by 30%.
Gains additional 3 stacks of Flower of Ice at the end of her own turn.

skills.name: Spring's Arrival (春告)
skills.description:
Exclusive effect.
Where spring breeze blows, everything springs to life. All allies gain a 25% increase todamage dealt and their SPD is increased by 20.

skills.name: Eternal Winter (永冬)
skills.line: The snow at the top of the mountain with never melt.
skills.description:
SP Yuki Onna turns into a cold ice lancer to attack a an enemy dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK and inflicts them with Frostbound. She also gains Thin Ice. When Thin Ice is lost, Frostbound is removed.
This skill cannot be used if there is a Frostbound enemy on the battlefield. ;Thin Ice (蝉翼) : :'''Buff, Mark''': An undispellable shield. It disappears at the start of SP Yuki Onna's turns and can absorb damage equal to 120% of her ATK.

upgrades.text: '''Frostbound''': Place on move bar cannot be altered is added as an additional effect.
'''Upper Hand''': Automatically gain Thin Ice at the start of battle.

bio.condition: Increase SP Yuki Onna's level to 40.
Increase SP Yuki Onna's skills 12 times.
In PVN zones, use Frost Breath once and win.
